name: Optional critical escalation
description: Optional table rule based on the owner's specified Fool's Gold-inspired critical tiers, with Dorks & Dice adaptations. A campaign can use normal critical hits without enabling escalation.

criticalSuccess.start: A natural 20 starts a critical chain and prompts an unmodified d20 escalation roll.
criticalSuccess.double: Another qualifying critical result raises the chain to double. An expanded critical range may qualify up to double only.
criticalSuccess.triple: Three consecutive natural 20s in combat reduce the attacked target to 0 HP. A non-20 result can never be part of a triple.
criticalSuccess.singleHitDamage: Maximum eligible base damage dice plus one additional roll of eligible damage dice.
criticalSuccess.doubleHitDamage: Maximum eligible base damage dice plus two additional rolls of eligible damage dice.

criticalFailure.start: A natural 1 begins an escalating failure chain.
criticalFailure.singleAndDouble: Situational consequences are adjudicated by the GM; no mandatory universal fumble table.
criticalFailure.triple: Three consecutive natural 1s reduce the failing character to 0 HP.

atZeroHP: Normal 5e-style death saving throws remain available; do not silently substitute 3.x negative-HP instant death.
unresolved: How supplemental damage dice and static bonuses enter the maximization arithmetic.
Interaction with external abilities that permit rerolling an escalation die.
